bites.title: Layers without the mouse
bites.body: Same moves as lesson 07, keyboard edition. I made two fruit layers to juggle.

bites.title: Duplicate
bites.body: Press {key:duplicatelayer|Ctrl+J}: a copy of the active layer.

bites.title: Walk the stack
bites.body: {key:activateNextLayer|PgUp} and {key:activatePreviousLayer|PgDown} move the selection up and down the stack.

bites.title: Move a layer
bites.body: {key:move_layer_up|Ctrl+PgUp} and {key:move_layer_down|Ctrl+PgDown} move the active layer itself.

bites.title: R + click: pick by pixel
bites.body: Hold R and click whichever fruit is NOT the active layer. Krita jumps to the layer you clicked. Fastest way to find a layer in a big painting.

bites.title: Quick group
bites.body: Press {key:create_quick_group|Ctrl+G}. The active layer goes into a new folder.

bites.title: Merge down
bites.body: Press {key:merge_layer|Ctrl+E}: the active layer melts into the one below. Use it when a part is finished, not before.

bites.title: 08 cleared
bites.body: Insert, Ctrl+J, PgUp/PgDn, Ctrl+PgUp/PgDn, R-click, Ctrl+G, Ctrl+E.
